content: When a UI panel embeds a structured JSON blob as a QR payload, the phone camera cannot drive a URL handler. Always prefer URL-shaped QR (`https://server/path?offer=<base64url(handshake)>`) over JSON blobs so the OS camera opens the URL natively. The `focusa-ui0y` Connect Page then becomes the entry point and renders Approve.
rationale: Observed in spec drift: spec said "generic camera scanning is not a success path" but the operator + self-host use case demands exactly that. Room state and security model are unchanged; only the QR shape changes.

trajectory.hlt: Maintain and improve Focusa within verified project scope
